subject.title: fix(streaming): preserve paragraph separators across block-streamed deliveries [AI-assisted]

question: Should the permanent block-streaming fix preserve paragraph boundaries with in-band text only, add explicit seam metadata, or accept a partial common-case repair for now?
rationale: The bug and common-case fix path are source-proven, but the exact `maxChars` boundary exposes a streaming payload contract choice that automation should not decide unilaterally.

options.title: Require complete shared preservation
options.body: Choose one candidate or replacement implementation and require it to preserve paragraph boundaries across both in-budget and exact-boundary splits before merge.

options.title: Adopt explicit seam metadata
options.body: Ask contributors to carry paragraph/newline/hard-split boundary semantics through the chunker, subscriber, and coalescer if text-only chunks cannot satisfy all invariants.

options.title: Accept partial text-only repair
options.body: Maintainers may intentionally land the common-case improvement while leaving the exact-boundary case documented as remaining work on the canonical issue.

recommendation.title: Require complete shared preservation
recommendation.body: Choose one candidate or replacement implementation and require it to preserve paragraph boundaries across both in-budget and exact-boundary splits before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: This account has strong history across block-reply coalescing and chunking hardening, making it the best available owner for the streaming boundary contract choice.
